ai.title: Agent setup
ai.description: Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key. Trio CRM calls the provider directly with your key - no per-seat AI fees, and your data stays yours. This powers AI-drafted replies in the inbox, the auto-reply bot, and the Playground.
ai.permissionNotice: Only admins and owners can change the AI configuration.
ai.providerKeyDescription: Your key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
ai.embeddingsDescription: An OpenAI key used only to embed your knowledge base (text-embedding-3-small){sameKey}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Clear it to turn semantic search off.
ai.sameKeySuffix: - can be the same key as above
ai.behaviourDescription: Tell the assistant about your business - products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
ai.businessContextPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates - hand off to a human for those.
ai.enableAssistantDescription: Master switch. Turns on the "Draft with AI" button in the inbox.
ai.autoReplyDescription: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can't help.
ai.maxAutoRepliesDescription: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet.

inviteMember.saveLinkDescription: We never store the plaintext - once you close this dialog the URL is gone. To re-share, revoke this invite and create a new one.
inviteMember.title: Invite a teammate
inviteMember.description: Generate a one-time invite link. Share it via WhatsApp, Slack, or any channel you like - no email service required.

roleDescriptions.admin: Can invite teammates, manage settings, send messages, and edit data.
roleDescriptions.agent: Can use the inbox, contacts, broadcasts, automations, and flows. No settings or member access.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Read-only access across every page. Cannot send or edit anything.
